svg.title: AxiomEngine request path
svg.desc: HTTP clients pass through Fiber middleware and the protected API to JSON or SSE plan handlers. JSON supports Idempotency-Key replay in memory or Redis. MCP over stdio calls the same ReasoningService implementation directly. The service validates input, extracts graph context, generates topics with concurrency and circuit-breaker limits, then merges and validates output. The graph uses an embedded seed or GRAPH_FILE. The BAML registry selects Amazon Bedrock by default, or OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible provider. Public probes and optional Swagger and metrics bypass API authentication. Topic routes read the graph. Optional OTLP and LangSmith exporters receive traces. Motion follows an HTTP request, then an MCP request.
